cohort: 20 male patients with Philadelphia-negative MPN at the National Center for Cancer Care and Research (NCCCR), Doha, Qatar
finding: Most Philadelphia-negative MPN male patients on treatment had their offspring born normally with no serious complications, congenital anomalies, or reports of MPN-related cancers.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery was normal vaginal delivery in 71.4% of the pregnancies.
